footer.tagline: Passes from verified gyms, monthly plans with trainers, and the tools to run your own gym.

landing.title: Run your gym without the paperwork
landing.lead: Members, monthly fees, attendance, reminders, staff and workout plans in one place, on your phone. Members find you, buy passes online and show a QR code at the front desk.
landing.featuresLead: Built with gym owners in Dhaka: simple enough for the front desk, clear enough for the owner.

members.title: Members
members.body: Every member with their package, start date and phone, searchable in seconds.

fees.title: Monthly fees
fees.body: See who has paid and who is due. Online payments go through Kriraghor and reach you as payouts.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Admit members at the front desk by QR code or a 6-character code, and see the day's visits.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Members get a reminder before their package ends, so renewals don't slip.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Give your front desk staff only the desks they need: admissions, passes sold, nothing else.

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.body: Trainers sell monthly plans; members follow them and pay each month on Kriraghor.
